357)༄༅/mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong drag mo las/rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs/snod min la gsang rgya/sbas rgya/gu h+ya/'phags

tei:div.tei:p: mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong drag mo las/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs/ snod min la gsang rgya/ sbas rgya/ gu h+ya/ 'phags bzhi bskyed yum sher phyin nyid// gzugs sku'i rol gar seng ge'i zhal// dbyer med bla ma la btud nas// rgyun gyi phrin las snying por dril// de la sbyor dongs rjes so/ dang po la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ byin rlabs gter mdzod bla ma dang: dngos grub rgya mtsho yi dam lha: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mkha' 'gro mar: byang chub ma thob bar du bdag skyabs mchi: sems bskyed ni/ rtsa ba gsum la skyabs song bas: byang chub sems ni rtag tu bsgom: bla med byang chub sems bskyed bgyi: bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nga ni bdud 'dul seng ge'i gdong: log par lta ba'i bgegs tshogs nyon: ngas ni gnas 'dir byang chub bsgrub: bgegs tshogs gang yin phyir dengs shig: oṃ ḍāk+ki kro dhi sum bha= srung 'khor ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung cho 'phrul las: mkha' 'gros gnam sa bar snang gang: me dpung mtshon cha'i gur khang las: su yang 'da' ba'i gnas med do: hrīḥḍāk+ki kro dhi gha ta gha ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: byin 'bebs ni/ hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub gsang chen klong yangs nas: ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong 'khor bcas rnams: bdag la 358)dbang bskur sgrub rdzas byin chen phob: dhā ki ni sa ma ya a we sha ya a a āḥ mchod brlab ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ pañtsa a mṛ ta ba ling+ta rak+ta bho dhi tsit+ta ga ṇa gu h+ya ar+ghaṃ= shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: gnyis pa rten dang brten pa'i lha bskyed ni/ hūm̐: ye nas chos rnams spros bral nyid: ma rtogs sems can snying re rje: skye ba med pa'i cho 'phrul las: 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab steng: pho brang mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs dbus: hūm̐ las mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong: dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: g.yas pas gri gug g.yon thod khrag:

zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'dor thabs 'gying: thabs kyi rang bzhin kha ṭ+wām̐ brten: dur khrod rus rgyan me klong bzhugs: spyi bor gu ru pad+ma bsam: phyogs bzhir pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i steng: rigs bzhi'i seng gdong las bzhi'i mdog: rang 'dra mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: phyi rim mkha' 'gro gdong can brgyad: khor yug dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: sgo bzhir sgo skyong ma bzhi rnams: 'ja' tshon lta bur gsal bar bsgom: oṃ dzñā na seng ha dhā ki ha ri ni sa sarba dhā ki ni sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐: yul gyi ming ni o rgyan rang bzhin gnas: mkha' spyod gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod nas: 359) ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong 'khor bcas rnams: dam tshig gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: seng ha dhā ki sarba sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bzhugs phyag ni/ hūm̐:mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong 'khor bcas rnams: chos 'byung pad nyi ro yi gdan la bzhugs: dpal chen myur mgyogs lha mo 'khor bcas la: brkyang bskum 'gying bag gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo: seng ha dhā ki sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: a ti pū hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐:mkha' 'gro seng gdong drag mo 'khor bcas kyis: nyer spyod 'dod yon lnga dang byang chub sems: sman gtor rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dbang dang dngos grub ma lus bdag la stsol: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe= shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa was+t+ra gu h+ya a mṛ ta ba ling ta rak+ta kha raṃ khā hiḥ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐:chos dbyings skye med ngang las ma g.yos kyang: gang 'dul zil gnon bgegs rnams 'joms mdzad pa: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo seng ge'i gdong pa can: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: dzapra la phyi sgrub ni/ thugs kar nyi steng baṃ hūm̐ mthar: sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor bar bsam: de las dza dmar sbrel ma las: srid pa gsum po dbang bsdus nas: ci 'dod 360)sgrub pa'i las byed bsam:

nang sgrub ni/ mdun rten seng gdong 'khor bcas gsal: 'khor 'das gzi byin de la bstim: sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bsam: bla ma yab yum sbyor mtshams nas: bdud rtsi spyi mgrin snying gar babs: snying de pad+ma 'dab bzhir bsam: spyi mgrin lte gsang thig le ni: dkar ser dmar ljang de yi dbus: ha ri ni sa gyen mthur spel: gsang 'og raṃ las khro chung spros: gdon bgegs gnod byed thams cad bsregs: tshur 'dus rang rgyud dug lnga bsregs: gsang sgrub ni/ gtso mo'i phyag g.yas lcags kyu ha dkar po mthur bstan/ ri ser po gyen sogs/ mchan/ dang: g.yon pas thod khrag nor bus mtshan: thugs las dzaḥdamar 'phros pa yis: 'khor rnams 'od zhu thugs kar thimaḥ bka' nyan las byed dbang bsdus bsamaḥ bla ma'i byang sems dang sbrags shing: tsakra bzhi yang 'od du zhu: sgo gsum sgrib pa dag par bsam: lte 'og me dkyil grub gsum nang: pad+ma he ru me mdog can: de las khro chung grangs med 'phrosaḥ tshur 'dus me dpung 'ur gyis 'baraḥ bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi babasaḥ stong nyid ma bcos ngang la bzhagaḥ oṃ baṃ seng ha dhā ki ha ri ni sa hūm̐: nig nal nig nal: pra mo thun pra mo thun: dbang po dkrug dbang po dkrug: sems rtsa myos sems rtsa myos: khug khug dzaḥdzaḥ zhag bdun bsnyen/ de'i gsham du/ oṃ bha ba nan: sa sa nan: si sa nan: rag ti nanaḥgator phud gtor phud: 361) sems rtsa dkrug sems rtsa dkrug: mngal gyi grong khyer dkrug: mngal gyi grong khyer dkrug: yang yang phud phud swa hāḥ sgrub pa zhag bdun/ bsnyen sgrub sngags sham du/ oṃ a ra el el nyol nyol phud phud swa hā: las sbyor zhag bdun dngos grub blang dmigs ni/ thugs ka'i dzaḥlas sgrub bya'i snying gar bzung: rkang zhabs rlung gis btegs te mdun du bkugaḥ 'od zhu rang gi thugs kar thim par bsamaḥ nyin gcig snga dror bsnyen sngags bzlas/ phyi dro sgrub sngags las sbyor sbrel ba'i sham du/

'gro ba thams cad sgrub pa po la myos par gyis: sbyar ba zhag bdun bzla/ las tshogs gzhan spro 'dod na lde mig ltar sbyor/ drag sgrub ni/ thugs kar nyi steng gser rdor rtse lnga'i lter: nyi zla'i ga'ur hūm̐ las sngags kyis bskor: lus nang mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bzlas par dmigs: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphāṭaḥ grangs bsnyen 'bum phrag bdun/ thun mthar/ mdun bskyed thugs nas 'od zer hūm̐ dang dza: tshur 'dus rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim: hūm̐ sgrub ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ 'phros pas: gnod byed thams cad brlag par gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐: bsnyen/ thun mthar rang gi thugs kar bsdu/ las tshogs rnams gzhung nas gsal/ tshe sgrub ni/ gtso bo'i phyag g.yas lcags kyu mda' dar 362)dang: g.yon pas pad+ma rā ga'i tshe bum bsnams: thugs kar nyi steng hrīḥyig zhabs kyu'i nang: nṛ yig gsal ba'i hrīḥmathar sngags kyis bskor: mkha' 'gro mang pos tshe yi bcud bsdus nas: snying ga'i tshe rten hrīḥdang nṛ la thim: rtsa sngags bcu'i gsham du/ aḥyu puṇ+ye sid+dhi tshe bh+rūm̐ hūm̐: srung ba ni/ steng du gser 'khor rtsibs stong g.yas su 'khor: 'og tu gnam lcags 'khor lo g.yon 'khor nang: gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu rgya che'i ltor: gser gyi mchod rten bum nang chos 'byung dbus: rang nyid mkha' 'gror gsal ba'i tsit+ta'i nang: ya ma rā dza dmar nag lcags 'khor dang: thod khrag tsit+ta bsnams pa'i thugs ka ru: gser rdor rtse lnga'i lte bar nyi zla'i dbus: hūm̐ gi khog par srung bya'i mthar sngags bskor: sngags bcu'i sham du/ ma ma rak+sha srung: oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakra srungs shig: he ka ya ma du ru tsakra srungs shig: ghṛ ma ya ma du ru tsakra srungs shigaḥ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarba tsit+ta gzer thum bigh+nān trig nan rbad ya bdag cag 'khor bcas la srungs shigaḥ bzlog dmigs ni/ lcags 'khor stong dang gser 'khor 'og tu gsal:

de nang rdo rje rtse dgu'i lte ba'i dbus: chos 'byung nang du 363)mkha' 'grau seng gdong ma: ya ma rā dza srung sngags dang bcas gsal: sprul pa grangs med phyag na 'khor lo can: g.yas g.yon nyi zla'i thal rdeb byad ma bzlog: sngags bcu'i gsham du/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i byad kha rbod gtong thams cad e sa bh+yo bh+yo bzlog: oṃ a ka ya ma du ru tsakra bzlog: he ka ya ma du: ghṛ ma ya ma sarba tsit+ta gzer thum bigh+nān trig nan rbad ya bzlog ya byad ma'i sha rus snying la mā ra ya: dbugs rgyud srog la mā ra ya: khrag rgyud rtsa la mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa bzlog ya: bsad dmigs ni/ chos 'byung dbus su gser 'khor lcags 'khor bar: byad ma gan kyal 'gyel ba'i snying ga na: seng gdong lcags kyu spu gri 'dzin pa yi: sku smad phur pas snying gi dbus su gzir: thugs kar gshin rje dkar dmar mthing ba'i zhal: phyag drug g.yas gnyis 'khor lo ral gri dang: g.yon gnyis lcags kyu gtun shing tha gnyis kyis: phur pa 'dril zhing sku smad phur pa'i dbal: sprul pa mang pos nad mtshon char pa 'bebs: lcags 'khor rtsibs drug 'khor bas srog rtsa bcad: rnam shes gshin rje'i thugs kar thim par bsam: sngags bcu bzhi'i 364) gsham du/ dgra bo nṛ srog snying la mā ra ya dza dza rbad: byad ma'i tshe dang bsod nams la mā ra ya dza dza rbad: e ka ya ma du ru tsakra sod: he ka ya ma= gh+ri ma ya la= sarba tsit+ta gzer thum bigh+nān trig nan rbadaya sod ya: sha rgyud snying la mā ra ya sod: khrag rgyud rtsa la mā ra ya sod: dbugs rgyud srog la mā ra ya sod: de rnams ci nus 'bad/ khyung sgrub ni/ rang nyid bya khyung dmar po'i gnas lnga ru: khyung chen rigs lnga gsal ba'i thugs ka ru: khroṃ mthar sngags kyis g.yas su 'khor bar bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra khroṃ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa: 'bum tsho gcig bzlas/ gsham ni/ oṃ pradzñā hasta khroṃ ga ru ḍa hūm̐:

rmya khyung khyung ha la ha la phyung phyung shig shig sarba s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: oṃ si li si li naṃ badz+ra ti shi nan bar zhum ha ri nan tsi li tsi li yam yam nan: lam lam sad sad sod sod hab phyung hab phyung nan nan sod phug phug sod phaṭa phaṭa sod phaṭa phaṭa swa hā khrol khrol swa hāḥ 'bum gcig bsnyen/ las tshogs gzhung du shes/ dam can nor sgrub ni/ mdun du nor bu'i gzhal yas su: srid gsum nor bdag dkar dmar mdangs: 'jol ber stag zhu sag lham mnabs: g.yas pas lcags kyu nor bu dang: g.yon pas lde mig ne 'u le: yum dmar 365) me long mda' dar bsnams: dar dkar na bza' g.yu thod can: seng ge dkar mo'i khri la rol: 'khor du dzaṃ la ser po brgyad: dge snyen nyer gcig brtan ma dang: mched 'khor sum brgya drug bcu gsal: 'o yug shangs nas spyan drangs gyur: kyai: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: nub phyogs gtsang gi 'o yug nas: gnod byin nor bdag 'khor dang bcas: dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol: rang rang mtshams pa'i gdan la bzhugs: dam rdzas 'di la brten gnas mdzod:rig 'dzin brgyud pas dam la bzhag: dam la bzhag bzhin dam la 'dus: rnam lnga bdud rtsi gser skyems bshos: rak+ta spos gsur ra yi tshil: bla mkhar smug po zur ma nyams: stag sgro srog 'khor nor gyi rdzong: /mda' dar me long srid gsum gsal: rin chen gser dngul g.yu mu tig: rnga khrab stag ras dar sna dang: 'bru sna dar gos spyan gzigs dkor: ra yi dbang lnga gri sgod snying: bkra shis rdzas brgyad rgyal srid bdun: seng ge ra skyes gtor ma sogs: yo byad mchod rdzas sna tshogs 'dis: nor bdag skyes bu 'khor bcas mchod: thugs dam gnyen po 366)bskang gyur cig: dgyes shing bdag la dngos grub stsol: bzlas dmigs ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las dza:dmar 'phros: lha klu mi yi gsang gnas nas: bzung ste dbang med rdzas la bstim: oṃ badz+ra sa dhu sa ma ya king ka ra hūm̐:

badz+ra li la ma hūm̐ dza: oṃ dzam+bha la dza lan+t+ra ye swa hā: tri dkar sha ling tri pra ma ni ging ka ra bh+yo rat+na sid+dhi ku ru hūm̐ dza dza tri'u pra ma dun kar ba skyes pa bud med sarba pa shaṃ tri ya rat+na sid+dhi pha la khug skyol: zhes bzla/ las sbyor gsham ni/ phur rta dza phur rta dza: snying ril ril tshor ba rak+ṣa thuṃ ril ril 'gro ba mi'i snying rtsa 'gul 'gul rat+na sid+dhi bh+rūm̐ 'dus 'dus dbang du 'dus mi snying bsgul bsgul srid gsum ka cha nga la shog: gnad dbab sngags ni/ tri dkar rta mo tra sha sa ni tri ru tri sha tri sha tra rgyas swa hā: brgya rtsa bzla/ rjes la tshogs kyi byin rlabs ni/ hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis dri ma sbyangs: oṃ ā: hūm̐ gis bdud rtsir rtogs: 'dod don nam mkhar mnyam par sbar: oṃ ā: hūm̐: tshogs spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐:yul gyi ming ni rang gzhin gnas: gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod nas: mkha' 'gro seng gdong 'khor dang bcas: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sman mchod ni/ 367)oṃ āḥhūm̐: mtshan ldan bhan+dza 'khor yug nang: dug lnga 'joms pa'i sman gyis bkang: mkha' 'gro seng gdong 'khor bcas la: bdud rtsi sman mchod dam pa 'bul: dhā ki ni pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: mchod pa ni hūm̐:mkha' 'gro seng gdong 'khor bcas la: mchog gi zhal zas tshogs mchod 'bul: brtse ba chen pos bzhes su gsol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: bshags pa ni/ bskal pa sngon nas da lta'i bar: ma rig ma rtogs nyam chags rnams: sman mchod tshogs kyi bshags par bgyi: dhā ki ni sa ma ya shud+dhe ā: bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: dur khrod chos 'byung 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su: pad+ma 'dab bzhi lte ba ro gdan dbus: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo seng ge'i gdong pa can: pho brang pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i gdan steng nas: gtso mo'i sprul pa rigs bzhi'i seng gdong ma: 'khor gyi las byed dhā ki rnamasapa brgyad:

phag gdong stag gdong chu srin gzig gdong ma: khyi gdong khra gdong spyang gdong 'ug gdong ma: gnas yul ma mo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro ma: dam can srung ma pho nya yang g.yog bcas: bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam gnyen po bskang: thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas mchod pa ni: dri zhim spos gsur rol mo'i sgra dbyangs snyan: 368)dpal gtor brjid mdangs tshogs 'khor longs spyod sprin: phyi nang gsang mchod gdung ba'i glu dbyangs dang:phyag rgya gar dang ting 'dzin gsal ba dang: sman gtor rak+ta byang sems dkar dmar dang: khrag zhag zhun chen la sogs bskang rjas kyis: thugs dam bskang ngo dbang dang dngos grub stsol: bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: nga ni bdud 'dul seng gdong ma: phyag mtshan phur bu 'dril zhing 'debs: sku smad gnam lcags dbal zur gsum: dgra bgegs snying gi dkyil du gzer: dhā ki kro dhi kī la ya nṛ tri shā tru?ṃ mā ra ya rbad: bstab pa ni/ hūm̐: seng gdong drag mo zhal phyes shig: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: chos dbyings skye med ngang du bstab: nyon mongs chos kyi dbyings su sgrol: dgra bgegs sha khrag rus gsum la khā hi:

tshogs drang ba ni/ ho: tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol: a la la ho: lhag ma ni/ hūm̐:mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can gyi: bka' 'khor phud lhag dbang ba rnams: zhal zas phud lhag 'di bzhes la: mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams bzlog: ga ṇa tsakra uts+tshiṣaṭa ba ling ta sarba khā hi: gtor bzlog bya ba ni/ mdun du gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang: nṛ las byad ma dngos su gsal: snying dkyil bdud 'dul 369)drag mo mthing: g.yas pas spu gri g.yon khrag zor: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: sku las mtshon cha'i char babs pas: dgra bo thal bar brlag par bsgom: hūm̐: o rgyan rang byung gnas mchog nas: gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod nas: bdud 'dul dpal chen khrag 'thung ma: rigs bzhi bdud 'dul nag mo bzhi: rdo rje phra man chen mo brgyad: dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu brgyad: bka' yi lha srin sde brgyad dang : ye shes bya khyung rgyal po rnams: bskul lo drag po'i phrin las bskul: mdzod cig bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: gsol lo dgra bo'i snying khrag gsol: drag po'i prin las dus la babs: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: sngags bzlog byed pa'i yi dam lha: mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams bzlog: yang gcig bzlog pa'i phrin las ni: bal mo'i ngan sngags 'ja' ltar 'khrugs pa dgra la bzlog: khrag zor mtshon ltar 'khrugs pa dgra= phur ba'i dbal kha thog ltar 'phangs pa dgra la= thun zor rbab ltar 'phen pa= lha yi bka' chad nyi ltar shar ba dgra la= bdud kyi bka' chad 370)ri ltar nyil ba dgra la= ma mo'i bka' chad mun ltar gtib pa dgra la= rgyal po'i bka' chad 'od du shar ba dgra la= klu yi bka' chad mdze grum snun pa dgra la= ban+de sngags pa'i phur zer= bon gyis smrang zer 'phro ba dgra la= dgra bcom 'bum skor byed pa dgra la= rbod stong rbad 'dre thams cad dgra la= ag+ne rā tsa'i bsreg mnan=

gtad mnan phung sel sna dgu dgra la= zhang zhung dzo byol dmar po dgra la= steng nas nyi zla gza' skar cho 'phrul dgra la= 'og nas sa bdag klu gnyan gdug rtsub dgra la= bzlog cig bdud 'dul khrag 'thung ma: sdang bar byed pa'i dgra la bzlog: gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du bzlog: za ba'i sri dang 'dre la bzlog: yid la brnag pa byad ma'i steng du bzlogaḥ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ kro dhi ha ri ni sa sarba dhā ki sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog: ma mo e ka tsa ti sa ma ya= btsan badz+ra du tri sa ma ya= bdud pra ma ni sa ma ya= gshin rje ya mā ra dza sa ma ya= gnod sbyin pak+sha e nyag sa ma ya= gza' bhisnu rā tsa sa ma ya= rgyal po ging ka ra tri= klu nā ga rā tsa ling sa ma ya= 371) srin po dha sha ru lu sa ma ya= mu stegs tri du sa ma ya= snang srid lha 'dre'i rbod gtong thams cad byad ma dgra bo'i thog tu bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog: byad kha phur kha dbal kha bzlog bzlog: gtad mnan phung sel bzlog bzlog: byad ma'i steng du e sa bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog: e dza bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog: zhes dang gong gi bzlog sngags grangs bsags/ bskul pa ni/ hrīḥ yul gyi ming ni rang bzhin o rgyan yul: gsang chen rol pa'i durakhrod chen po nas: ma gcig mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong pa can: khro 'dzum rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs pa las: las bzhi thogs med sgrub pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub bdag la stsol: bcol pa'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod: chad tho ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bskal pa dang po la: slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gis:

ma mo mkha' 'gro dam la btags: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' bar: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: zor 'phang ni/ hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas dbu la bzhugs: rtsa gsum srung mas gzu dpang mdzod: khrag 'thung 'khor bcas zor la bzhengs: gtor zor byad ma'i steng du rgyob: hūm̐: rak+ta rba rlabs 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: 372) ma mo bdud 'dul nag mo mthu rtsal can: drag rtsal rigs bzhi phra men chen mo brgyad: dbang phyug nyer brgyad lha srin sde brgyad kyi: sku la dug dang mtshon cha'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: thams cad dgra la sdang mig hrigs se hrig: stong gsum 'jig rten ma lus g.yo zhing 'gul: gtum chen las kyi gtor zor gnyen po 'di: sdang byed dgra dang gnod byed bgegs tshogs dang: yid la brnag pa'i byad ma'i steng du rgyob: bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog zor ya zor ya: brtan ma ni/ bh+yo: slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gi: bka' nyan ma mo brtan ma'i tshogs: dam rdzas dpal gyi gtor ma longs: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: ma ma la la ting ting hring hring sarba ba ling ta khā hi: bro mnan ni/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gnam sa gang : bro ni ma mo mkha' 'gro'i bro: rdung ni ye shes ngang nas rdung: nyon mong dgra bgegs rang sar dag: ha ri ni sa shan+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ wa shaṃ mā ra ya nan: oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ suṃ laṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: na sha ya nan: gong ltar mchod bstod dang*/ bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: ye shes mkha' 'gro 'khor gyi bka' nyan tshogs: bdag ni ma rig mi dge'i 'gal 'khrul rnams: skye med chos dbyings ngang du bshags par bgyi: oṃ dzñā na dhā ki sa twa sa ma ya= sogs dang dbyangs gsal bcas brjod/ 373) dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: ma gcig seng gdong dngos grub kun gyi mdzod: snyen sgrub mchod bstod dang du blangs pa yis: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dngos grub kun: dus las mi 'da' da lta nyid du stsol/

sngags mthar/ sid+dhi pha la a la la ho: rten bzhugs ni/ ye dhar dang/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir: nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni: ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid par: de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol: lhar snang bsdu ba ni/ snang srid ma lus rang gi sku la thim: rang nyid thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la thim pas: de yang de dbus thugs srog hūm̐ la thim: thugs srog hūm̐ yang mi dmigs nam mkha' ltar: rjes thob ni/ hūm̐: rang lus 'byung ba lnga dang skye mched tshogs: ye nas rang byung rang rtsal yi dam lha: thabs shes dbyer med lta spyod zung 'brel nas: rgyun du 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam bya'o: bsngo smon ni/ skal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas: mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma dang smon lam stobs: 'di nas bzung ste gdod ma chos sku'i bar: mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma dang 'bral med shog: bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dngos grub rnam gnyis mdzod: zag med mchog la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog: rigs bzhi'i seng gdong phrin las sgrub pa'i lha: 374) las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: sna tshogs dhā ki bka' nyan las byed lha: phrin las sna tshogs 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: bdag la mos pas ma 'ongs rjes 'jug rnams: phrin las sna tshogs gang dang gang sgrubs kyang : bar chad med par myur du 'grub par shog: zhes pa'ang sgrub brtson dam pa chos dbang gi zhal 'don du pad+ma ma ṇis gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rnams gung bsgrigs te khyer bder bris pa dge legs 'phel// bkra shis//
